slides.text: Warehouse robots won't book your viewings
slides.voiceover_text: Nvidia's robots won't answer your phones. But the orchestration tech behind them trickles down, and I see it working for letting agents around Hampshire.
Tip one: if a vendor pitches cutting-edge robotics, be sceptical. Your viewing bookings don't need it.
Tip two: ask how the system routes calls and captures applicant details without dropping the ball.
Tip three: make sure it logs every enquiry straight into your CRM and follows up automatically.
So remember: it's reliability that captures enquiries and books viewings, not the buzzwords.
